verdict.rationale: USCIS's own pages state that forms can be filed through a secure online filing system with fees paid online by card or ACH, using a free myUSCIS account, and they name specific online-fileable forms (N-400, I-90, I-130). Representatives can also file online alongside Form G-28. Missing for 10: evidence that founder- or business-relevant forms (not just the listed popular personal forms) are fileable online, a published list showing which forms are online-only versus paper-only, and independent or hands-on corroboration of completing a filing end-to-end.
